title: Silver IRS Reporting Thresholds
narration: This chart highlights the key thresholds for reporting silver sales to the IRS.  A sale exceeding $10,000 to a dealer or $20,000 in total sales during a year triggers reporting requirements.  The IRS issued over 30 million 1099-K forms in 2023, and the average cost of tax preparation is $268, emphasizing the importance of accurate record-keeping.
